subject: probe3WayMC - plotProbe - change name of the second moderator

messages.author: 17944621d521fdfa
messages.subject: probe3WayMC - plotProbe - change name of the second moderator
parts:
I would like to plot a three-way latent interaction. How do I change the name of the second moderator on each of the three panels displayed using plotProbe? 

This works for a two-way interaction:
xlab = "name1",
ylab = "name2",
legendArgs = list(title = "moderator"))

I tried looking at ?par but no luck so far. 

Thank you,

Fran

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: probe3WayMC - plotProbe - change name of the second moderator
parts:
You can't access the main= argument that way because a list of them must be created inside the function.  Just change the name of the factor to "moderator" when you fit the model.
